RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, December 4, 2012/Agrahayana 13, 1934 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Environment and Forests; Health and Family
Welfare; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Power; Road Transport and Highways; Shipping)
Total number of questions — 20
Higher cost of petroleum products in
India
*141. SHRIMA TI KUSUM RAI: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that petroleum
products are cheaper in Nepal and Sri Lanka
than in India;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Nepal imports petrol and
other petroleum products from India;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the reasons for petrol, diesel and
other petroleum products costing more in
India than in Nepal when almost the whole
requirement of petroleum products of
Nepal is supplied by India?
Leakage from oil pipeline in
Tamil Nadu
*142. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE : W ill the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NA TURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(a) whether Government is aware of an
incident of oil leak which took place recently
in Nagapattinam district of Tamil Nadu;
(b) whether the oil leak was caused by
an unused pipeline of the Oil and Natural
Gas Commission (ONGC); and
(c) whether ONGC has any Disaster
Management system in place to handle such
situations?
Cleaning of rivers
†*143. SHRI THAAW AR CHAND
GEHLOT: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of action plans being
implemented by Government for cleaning
of Ganga and Yamuna rivers;
(b) the details of funds spent, so far, on
the cleaning of both these rivers, year-wise
till date; and
(c) by when the Ganga and Yamuna
rivers would be made pollution free?

44
Transfer of NHAI officials
*144. SHRI BHARATSINH
PRABHATSINH PARMAR: W ill the
Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of field officials of the
National Highways Authority of India
(NHAI) who having served more than five
years in the same State, have been
transferred as on date to other States in
different projects to minimize corruption
in NHAI, project-wise and State-wise;
(b) whether NHAI has received any
communication from the Central Vigilance
Commission (CVC) in this regard;
(c) if so, whether NHAI has responded
to the CVC in this regard;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the details of further action taken by
NHAI in this regard?
Power crisis in Andhra Pradesh
*145. SHRIMATI GUNDU
SUDHARANI: Will the Minister of
POWER be pleased to state:
(a) the names of  States  which  are
reeling under severe power crisis;
(b) whether Andhra Pradesh is the third
amongst the States in the country facing
severe power crisis; and
(c) if so, the reasons for not allocating
the unallocated power from the Southern
Grid to Andhra Pradesh by the Ministry?
Revenue fixing system in airports
*146. SHRI NARESH GUJRAL: Will
the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether a Dual Till system of
revenue fixing is being followed at Mumbai
and Delhi airports whereas airports in the
rest of the country follow a Single Till
system;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) the reasons for not linking the
revenue being collected from commercial
exploitation of land with the fixing of
targeted revenue collection in Delhi Airport;
and
(d) the reasons for Government allowing
fixing of the targeted revenue formula in
such a way that it shall never be met without
burdening passengers?
Cleaning of Gujarat coast
*147. SHRI DILIPBHAI PANDY A:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has reimbursed
the expenditure incurred on cleaning of the
Gujarat coast;
(b) if not, the reasons for delay; and
(c) the details of action taken against oil
companies operating their facilities at
Mukta-Panna basin and responsible for the
oil spillage?
Delay in land acquisition for highway
projects
*148. SHRI AAY ANUR
MANJUNATHA: Will the Minister of
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether delay in land acquisition
has impacted the completion of roads and
highway projects in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof along with
the number of such projects, State-wise
and NH-wise;
(c) the details of major constraints being
faced by the National Highways Authority
of India (NHAI) in acquiring land for its
highway projects; and

45
(d) the action taken or proposed to be
taken by Government to expedite the
acquisition of land for roads and highway
projects?
